Messages.Author: gcwilson67
Messages.Body:
Thanks to everyone that has taken the time to have a look at my designs. I really welcome the feedback and will take the suggestions made into consideration.

The format is A4, though I have thought about using a letter sized (215.9mm x 279.4mm) page, however, A4 would make more sense.

Rulebook #2 is horizontal, as I thought this would be more appropriate for viewing on screen.

I agree that the cleaner page backgrounds would be visually better, as well as keep the finished file size as small as possible - helpful when viewed on an ipad or similar device. It will also make it a little more ink friendly, should anyone want to print it.

I do have one thing to ask though, so I apologise if this is out of line, but would it be possible to use the font used for the Disciplines and other game icons? The pdf's of Danse Macabre and The Unaligned list it as the AnkhaVTES font. A google search brings up a webpage ankha-vcm, but the source path does not have a link to the .ttf file.
Using a font, instead of images of each icon, would make things a lot easier. If anyone knows how to gain access to the font file, I would really appreciate the help!

In the meantime, I will work on refining the layouts and hope to have them posted in the next week or so.

Cheers

It looks good, but for the terrible card scans. I'd probably split the disciplines in two groups, "standard" and "expert".

Standard: animalism, auspex, celerity, dementation, dominate, fortitude, obfuscate, obtenetration, potence, presence, protean, thaumaturgy, vicissitude

Expert: the rest (mainly bloodlines & clan-disciplines).

Messages.Author: gcwilson67
Messages.Body:
Hi there

Second draft of the rulebook here:
www.dropbox.com/s/wb93uc4akfmbwio/VTES%20Rulebook%20141215.pdf?dl=0

I'd like to think that this is the final version, unless people notice any glaring mistakes...

The spelling of Valeren is now correct, as the main text was copied directly from the online rules everything else should be OK, I have spell-checked it several times and not noticed any other errors.
The images have been improved, the original quality was due to the low resolution settings when I created the pdf, rather than the scans themselves.
The cover has been amended, and I have added the Imbued appendix and a quick reference page. The pdf is also bookmarked and indexed so, along with the links in the text, it should be easily navigable. If anyone finds any links missing or that don't work, please let me know.

Thanks to everyone that has commented so far, and I hope it proves useful to old and new players alike!

Cheers

Messages.Author: Walt
Messages.Body:
Hi

great work, I really like it

I find few minor issues reading it

page 3, 1.5 (crypt overview) point 3 (clans):
"See the reference pages in the center of the rules booklet for a list of the clan symbols"

you place the clan list at pages 18 and 19, no more in center

page 5, top left:
"A drop of blood with a number on the left side of ..."

there are no references to old cards blood/pool symbols (white and black drop). Maybe could be usefull to add them

page 6: Govern the unaligned card

miss the red 6 on card text

page 7: 8: powers

you place a power card here and also in the imbued section but there is no conviction card here
in my opinion you could remove power description here and add a note who point to imbued section for other type of cards

page 7: 1.6.4. Event Cards

there is 1.6.4 intead of 9 to indicate event cards
also no number on the event card

page 10: 6.1.7. Political Action (+1 stealth)
.... A minion cannot perform more than one political action each turn."

as stated above in the same paragraph only vampires can play a political card so I suggest to replace "minion" with "vampire"

page 19, Wording Templates.
on 4th line of “During X, do Y” start a new template, “Cancel a card” without a new line and a bold

page 20, top left, 4th row
a new template "“Tap X to do Y”:" start with no new line and bold
also on line 10 start “Search”

ciao

Stefano "Walt" Calzighetti
Prince of Pordenone (Italy)
